2.t: and you [Prophet] are an inhabitant of this city––

4.t: that We have created man for toil and trial.

5.t: Does he think that no one will have power over him?

6.t: ‘I have squandered great wealth,’ he says.

7.t: Does he think no one observes him?

8.t: Did We not give him eyes,

10.t: and point out to him the two clear ways [of good and evil]?

11.t: Yet he has not attempted the steep path.

12.t: What will explain to you what the steep path is?

13.t: It is to free a slave,

14.t: to feed at a time of hunger

16.t: or a poor person in distress,

17.t: and to be one of those who believe and urge one another to steadfastness and compassion.

18.t: Those who do this will be on the right-hand side,

19.t: but those who disbelieve in Our revelations will be on the left-hand side,

20.t: and the Fire will close in on them.
